"""
    Query Materials Project for semiconductor-packaging thermal-management candidates.
    Focuses on high thermal-conductivity / low-coefficient-of-thermal-expansion materials.
    """
    default_criteria = {
        "formula": {"$not": {"$regex": ".*O.*"}},  # exclude simple oxides as baseline
        "elements": {"$all": ["Al", "Cu", "Ag", "SiC", "BN", "C", "W"]},
    }
    if criteria is None:
        criteria = default_criteria

    with MPRester(api_key or os.getenv("MP_API_KEY")) as mpr:
        # Real MPRester call — not a placeholder
        results = mpr.query(
            criteria,
            ["material_id", "formula_pretty", "structure", "band_gap", "formation_energy_per_atom"],
            chunk_size=max_results,
        )
        records = []
        for doc in results:
            records.append({
                "mp_id": doc.get("material_id"),
                "formula": doc.get("formula_pretty"),
                "band_gap_ev": doc.get("band_gap"),
                "formation_energy_ev_atom": doc.get("formation_energy_per_atom"),
                "structure": doc.get("structure"),
            })
    df = pd.DataFrame(records)
    return df
action.new_str:
"""
    Query Materials Project (mp-api) for thermal-management / insulation candidates.
    Includes compounds with at least one of B, C, N, Si, Al.
    Extracts: Material ID, Pretty Formula, Bulk Modulus (VRH avg), Band Gap.
    Drops rows with missing Bulk Modulus or Band Gap.
    """
    elements_filter = ["B", "C", "N", "Si", "Al"]
    criteria = {
        "elements": {"$in": elements_filter},
        "nelements": {"$gte": 1},
    }

    with MPRester(api_key or os.getenv("MP_API_KEY", API_KEY)) as mpr:
        results = mpr.query(
            criteria,
            [
                "material_id",
                "formula_pretty",
                "bulk_modulus.vrh",
                "band_gap",
            ],
            chunk_size=max_results,
        )
        records = []
        for doc in results:
            bulk_mod = doc.get("bulk_modulus", {}).get("vrh") if isinstance(doc.get("bulk_modulus"), dict) else doc.get("bulk_modulus")
            if bulk_mod is None:
                bm = doc.get("bulk_modulus")
                if isinstance(bm, dict):
                    bulk_mod = bm.get("vrh")
                else:
                    bulk_mod = bm
            records.append({
                "material_id": doc.get("material_id"),
                "formula_pretty": doc.get("formula_pretty"),
                "bulk_modulus_vrh": bulk_mod,
                "band_gap_ev": doc.get("band_gap"),
            })
    df = pd.DataFrame(records)
    df = df.dropna(subset=["bulk_modulus_vrh", "band_gap_ev"])
    df = df[(df["bulk_modulus_vrh"].notna()) & (df["band_gap_ev"].notna())]
    return df
